title: City of San Diego Prepares for Rain
description:
More rain is on the way to San Diego, and we’re getting ready. 🌧️ 

Rain is expected over the next few days and possibly into the weekend. City of San Diego crews are preparing by inspecting storm drains, pump stations, channels and other stormwater infrastructure. San Diego Fire-Rescue's Lifeguard swiftwater rescue teams are pre-positioned across the City. 

Before the rain, residents can take a few simple steps: 
- Sweep and pick up trash, leaves, grass clippings and other debris that collect around storm drains and curb gutters near your home.
- Proactively turn off irrigation to save water and minimize runoff. 
- Know the safest routes to and from your home or property should flooding occur. 
- SLOW DOWN and do not drive, ride or walk through flood waters. 

To report storm-related issues, like flooding or fallen branches, report them on the Get It Done app or call 619-527-7500. If you have an emergency, dial 911.
